_comment: Per-unit overrides on top of data/bsdata/parsed.json. Each entry can partially override any field (health, damage, hit_probability, ap, save, name, enabled, notes). Standalone entries listed here that don't exist in parsed.json become fully hand-rolled units; they must specify all required fields.

necrons_necron_warriors.notes: 10e Necron Warriors carry the Their Number Is Legion rule — they have OC equal to a normal infantryman PLUS hold objectives even after leaving them. Sourced from wahapedia.ru Necrons datasheet.

genestealer_cults_acolyte_hybrids_with_h.notes: 10e GSC Acolyte Hybrids have Cult Ambush which keeps objective control after the unit leaves. Sourced from wahapedia.ru Genestealer Cults datasheet.

genestealer_cults_acolyte_hybrids_with_a.notes: 10e GSC Acolyte Hybrids have Cult Ambush which keeps objective control after the unit leaves. Sourced from wahapedia.ru Genestealer Cults datasheet.

death_guard_plague_marines.notes: Death Guard army rule Disgustingly Resilient grants every DEATH GUARD model FNP 5+. The rule is codex-level and is not encoded on individual BSData datasheets, so the mapper cannot see it — override here. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/death-guard/ (Army Rule: Disgustingly Resilient). | sweg_balance_mc up 22.5 -> 24.75 pts/model

chaos_space_marines_plague_marines.notes: Cross-codex BSData entry for Plague Marines; canonical datasheet lives in the Death Guard codex and carries Disgustingly Resilient (FNP 5+). Pricing and stats are identical to death_guard_plague_marines. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/death-guard/#Plague-Marines.

aeldari_craftworlds_wraithguard.notes: Wraithguard have a 4+ invulnerable save listed on their datasheet, but BSData does not encode it (no Invulnerable-Save infoLink in the unit entry). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/aeldari/#Wraithguard. | sweg_balance_mc up 218.68 -> 240.55 pts/model

aeldari_craftworlds_wraithblades.notes: Wraithblades have a 4+ invulnerable save listed on their datasheet, but BSData does not encode it. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/aeldari/#Wraithblades.
